channel.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI
channel.description: A non-AI view of GitHub Trending — a daily digest of open-source tools, libraries, languages, and projects trending right now.

item.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI — September 11, 2026
item.description:
Today's 54 trending open-source repositories, with AI-focused projects filtered out. Highlights:

  1. public-apis/public-apis (478,920 ⭐) — A collective list of free APIs
  2. freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp (455,312 ⭐) — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
  3. EbookFoundation/free-programming-books (396,529 ⭐) — :books: Freely available programming books
  4. nilbuild/developer-roadmap (366,899 ⭐) — Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
  5. awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted (318,530 ⭐) — A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
  6. practical-tutorials/project-based-learning (282,967 ⭐) — Curated list of project-based tutorials
  7. react/react (250,039 ⭐) — The library for web and native user interfaces.
  8. torvalds/linux (248,253 ⭐) — Linux kernel source tree
  9. TheAlgorithms/Python (224,480 ⭐) — All Algorithms implemented in Python
  10. microsoft/vscode (192,008 ⭐) — Visual Studio Code
